description: Log an outcome/correction as a learning signal. Required: agent_id, subject_type ('episode'|'event'|'todo'|'tool_call'|'message'), signal ('approved'|'rejected'|'corrected'|'rated'|'edited'). Optional: subject_id, correction (the fix — highest-value), rating (1-5), source.

signal.description: Kind of feedback: approved, rejected, corrected, rated or edited

subject_type.description: What the feedback is about: episode, event, todo, tool_call or message

name: record_feedback
